Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You pause, find a familiar angle in the unfamiliar world, and choose your way.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
An unfamiliar place with usable landmarks; one minute
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Ordinary navigation is possible without the card. No routine travel roll; only consequential uncertainty. No magic compass when evidence is absent.

Weak
1 progress toward finding your way; identify a visible landmark you can use to retrace this attempt.
Standard
2 progress and identify your return direction.
Strong
3 progress and describe a recognizable landmark to companions.
